KeyC works and gives feedback ("no-bench"). So input IS registering. Movement holds just aren't moving me. 

This is very odd. KeyE and KeyC (presses) work, but movement (holds) don't. Maybe the game's movement requires the player to be the one moving, and my body is a companion that's "anchored" to the player. 

Wait — maybe the issue is that I'm standing on the notice board tile which is a blocking object, and the game won't let me move off a blocking tile (a soft-lock). But the map shows '@' not 'o' there.

Let me try: maybe I need to move the PLAYER. But I can only control my own body. Unless... the "Player Tester" is actually me and "You" is a companion? No, observe clearly says "You: Workshop (2,7)".

Let me try holding a movement key for a very long time with until condition, and also try diagonal by holding two keys.
